name: Bento Gallery
description: Dense bento-style image grid with mixed column and row spans. Images dim until hovered, then brighten and zoom with an accent border, and clicking opens a fullscreen lightbox.
contents: Grid of image tiles with optional column and row spans
Fullscreen lightbox with image, caption, counter, close and previous/next buttons
behavior: Tiles are dimmed and brighten with zoom, accent border and expand icon on hover or focus
Click opens a lightbox with fade and slide-up animation
Escape closes, arrow keys navigate, navigation wraps around
Page scroll is locked while the lightbox is open
editableByProps: Images, alt text and tile spans
Number of columns on screens wider than 640px

needsCodeEdit.where: auto-rows and gap classes on the main grid element

needsCodeEdit.change: Change dimming level of idle tiles
needsCodeEdit.where: brightness-[0.55] class on the tile img
background style in the Modal root div

fixed: Sets body overflow hidden while the lightbox is open and resets it on close and unmount
Adds a window keydown listener while the lightbox is open
Spans apply only on screens wider than 640px, evaluated at render
